scope: All 180 nominal/bank performance episodes from the complete 390-run integration, all 30 conditions and all three fixed models. Includes every old baseline-failure condition. Old 15 initials only; no effect selection or independent efficacy evidence.
timing_scope: Paired orders remain those frozen in V37. Aggregate timing spans two desktop epochs after an interruption and is not a hard-real-time or single-session benchmark.
work_scope: Original planning counters remain logical reference work. Additional cache counters report hits/misses, capacity skips and successfully computed transitions. Work inside failed planner calls remains uncounted; full callback times retain it.
